# Talento

> Open-source web app that compares a résumé (CV) with a job offer using Google Gemini: ATS-oriented match analysis, gap detection, rewrite suggestions, and an interview simulator.

## Product
- Name: Talento
- Live demo: https://cv-compare.up.railway.app
- Repository: https://github.com/mickaelrebeau/CV-Offer-Comparer
- License: MIT
- Language: French UI (primary)
- Author: Mickael Rébeau

## What it does
1. Extracts requirements from a job offer
2. Compares them semantically with a CV (Gemini)
3. Streams match / missing / unclear criteria via SSE
4. Suggests ATS-friendly reformulations
5. Generates interview questions from real gaps
6. Stores comparison history for authenticated users (Postgres)
7. Does not permanently store CV/offer documents (processed in memory for the session; content is sent to Google Gemini for analysis)

## Stack
Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, Tailwind, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Google Gemini, PostHog (product analytics), Railway.
